description:
National public holidays between two dates: data.holidays[] {date, name} by date, plus one citation per year in data.facts[]. Use it to check travel dates for closures and crowds; get_country_facts has this year's list with other facts, get_trip_brief covers a whole trip. Data spans the current year and the next two (outside: empty list plus coverage_note); no regional holidays. Each fact is cited: sources[] (url, license), last_verified, confidence.
Parameters: from and to are inclusive: pass the travel dates, or YYYY-01-01 to YYYY-12-31 for a year. Over two years, or to before from, is an error. Example: {"country":"JP","from":"2026-12-28","to":"2027-01-05"}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

from.description: First day of the range (inclusive). Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.

to.description: Last day of the range (inclusive), on or after from and at most two years later. Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_public_holidays

attribution.description: Attribution strings to show to users when you display these facts.

country.description: Country (ISO codes and name, localized to lang).

coverage_note.description: Present when there is no data for the range.

facts.description: One cited fact per calendar year covered (value replaced by holiday_count).

attribution.description: Attribution strings required by the source licenses.

confidence.description: Deterministic confidence: score from 0 to 1, a level, and the reasons (source kind, cross-checks, staleness...).

reasons.description: Why the score is what it is.

cross_checks.description: Independent datasets the value was checked against, with the result.

last_verified.description: Date the value was last verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

next_review_due.description: Date of the next scheduled review (YYYY-MM-DD).

license.description: License of the source, e.g. CC0-1.0, OGL-UK-3.0, MIT.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source, when quoted.

source_value.description: The raw value as given by the source, when not quoted.

holidays.description: Holidays in the range, sorted by date.

fact_id.description: The yearly fact (in facts[]) that lists this holiday.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset that answered.

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): RFC 9457 problem, e.g. unknown country, no data, key required, rate limited, sanctions block.
anyOf.title: Error (problem details)

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): x402 v2 payment requirements. Pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"].
anyOf.title: Error (x402 payment request)

title: Public holidays
